title: Lightweight but Linguistically Fair? Quantisation Robustness across Bavarian, German, and English

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance degradation (dialect-gap amplification) of language models after post-training quantisation on aligned multiple-choice questions and free-form generation tasks across a regional dialect (Bavarian) versus standard languages (German and English).

Evaluating model robustness on the BAVGROUND benchmark, which tests regional and general cultural knowledge across eight domains, to determine if quantisation disproportionately harms the representation of regional cultural knowledge.
